mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.status, c.admin_remark, c.reviewed_at, c.created_at, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar, (CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(u.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_admin FROM article_comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.status, c.admin_remark, c.reviewed_at, c.created_at, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar, (CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(u.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_admin FROM article_comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.status, c.admin_remark, c.reviewed_at, c.created_at, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar, (CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(u.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_admin FROM article_comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_comments (article_id, user_id, parent_id, content, status) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE article_comments SET status = #{status}, admin_remark = #{adminRemark}, reviewed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
